paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bava Batra 12a, in a halakhic ruling.[^1]

notes.text: The stored William Davidson Edition of Bava Batra 12a has רבא בר קסנא in a halakhic vineyard-share ruling; the supplied heading spells קיסנא. That spelling difference is preserved, and the ruling is not imported into the brief notice.
